prompts.prompt: Create production sprite sheet for this exact Yellow Turban sickle soldier. Transparent background. EXACT uniform 4 columns x 3 rows, 12 equal square cells, no gaps, no labels, no grid lines. Each sprite entirely within its cell with consistent scale, feet baseline at 88% cell height and body centered x=50%, weapon fits margins. Preserve this cute big head short body yellow headband outfit and weapon. Row 1 ALL facing DOWN towards viewer, row 2 ALL facing RIGHT side profile, row 3 ALL facing UP away from viewer showing BACK of head with NO face. In EVERY row: column 1 walk pose left bean foot forward; column 2 walk pose right bean foot forward with opposite body lean; column 3 attack WINDUP raising sickle backwards with both arms; column 4 attack STRIKE swinging sickle forward in that row's facing direction, arms extended and torso leaning forward. Weapon always physically gripped in hands. Clearly different arm and weapon poses between windup and strike. No effects, no detached weapons, no shadows. Flat cartoon bold outlines, simple readable at small scale. Exact 4x3 aligned atlas layout essential.
